product_one_liner.value: Fly.io is a developer-focused public cloud for deploying and running full-stack applications, databases, and agents on hardware-isolated virtual machines close to users.
product_one_liner.notes: Fly.io describes itself as a developer-focused global cloud and currently markets app, database, and agent workloads.

pricing_page.notes: Public page lists prices and billing rates.

named_customers.notes: Both appear among the named customer stories.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn range is 51–200 while PitchBook reports 58 employees; 58 falls in the requested 51–100 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn company profile identifies Chicago, Illinois as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company says it has been building since 2017.

eng_blog.notes: The company publishes multiple technical engineering/infrastructure articles, including posts on scheduler design, machine migration, and Sprite implementation.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes product guides and API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current listed roles are engineering, infrastructure, networking, and platform security; no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title is listed.

model_provider.value: Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter (named for internal tooling use in its subprocessors disclosure)
model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list names these providers for internal AI-assisted tasks; it does not state that a particular model provider powers Fly.io's customer-facing product.

compliance_certs.notes: Fly.io says it has a SOC 2 Type 2 report. HIPAA BAA is available but is not itself listed as a certification. It explicitly does not hold ISO 27001 or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The July 24, 2026 announcement reports $25 million in Series D funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 2026 Series D falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current listed roles contain no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Fly.io announced its computers-for-agents product direction and new Sprites iteration on July 24, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The July 24, 2026 announcement says Scott Johnston joined as CEO and board member.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Readable job listings and public product documentation reviewed; neither names CRM or sales/marketing systems.
